extractionHelicopter.asset: Extraction_Helicopter_Speed_Curve_Entry (used by the entry and the exit path)
extractionHelicopter.mover: WDQuestNodeLatentAction_WaitForVehicleMovedAlongSpline tick 0x88A48E0: distance += Curve(distance / splineLength) x deltaTime, clamped to the spline length (USplineComponent length, Unreal units = cm), so the value is cm per second
extractionHelicopter.unit: cm/s (3 m/s up to 70 percent of the path, then easing to 1 m/s)

flareRestock.addHandler: 0x767E260 via OnItemAdded 0x7689D10: on the authority, when the added item tag equals the flare tag, CurrentFlaresAmount (+0x790) += Delta, replicate, then broadcast 0x7673540 (Client_FlaresRestocked)
flareRestock.smoke: same handlers: the smoke block (+0x350) count at +0x7B4 follows its own item tag

hotZoneMagnet.activationHandler: 0x85674A0 (authority-side activation handler; it reads as the rig or tower activation) and client function 0x8571F80: the hot-zone cache extents are multiplied component-wise by the world component's size multiplier and the result is handed to the control-zone component callback 0x8571E20; the tower number, durations and location are stored by 0x856FE50 and replicated

rigDataAssetValues.note: The rig data asset carries its own pair; the two activation functions read the world component's pair at +0xF8 (0.6, 0.6, 1.0 by default), not the rig's.

hotZoneMagnet.sizeMultiplierFieldOffset: +0xF8 (vector); speed +0xF0 (float, read only through the Blueprint getter 0x8573ED0)

pawnUnitSystems.aiPerception: SightRadius 200000 and HearingRange 100000 are Unreal units (cm): 2,000 m and 1,000 m

assignment.factionsCreatedAt: 0x864A150 (BeginPlay hook): one faction actor spawned per pool entry
assignment.rule: each joining player goes to the non-default faction with the fewest members (lowest count; the first one wins a tie), so with 100 or fewer players everyone is alone

sniperShowdown.lootPointNote: WDGameFrameworkComponentReceiver actors with tags Lootable.SniperOnly.{High,Middle,Low}Value in the Sniper Showdown data-layer cells (10 cells per map).

teamOffence.defaultsNote: Constructor values; DefaultGame.ini excerpt carries no TeamOffence section, so these apply.

notices.Notice.TeamOffence.OffenderPunished: You were punished for a team offence. You have {Points} of {Threshold} points before a kick vote.
notices.Notice.TeamOffence.VoterExpired: You were removed from the vote on {OffenderName}: no decision was made within {Seconds} seconds.
notices.Notice.TeamOffence.VoterKick: {OffenderName} was punished, they have been banned.
notices.Notice.TeamOffence.VoterSafeZoneForgive: You left the safe zone before deciding, so your vote on {OffenderName} was recorded as Forgive.

tyreStateWriter.binding: 0x5356B00 binds it to each wheel's health attribute
tyreStateWriter.states: 0 intact, 1 damaged (health / max health at or below the trigger threshold, 55 percent in the cooked triggers), 2 destroyed (health 0); byte array at +0x9B0, replicated (copy at +0x9D8), change handler 0x5370A40 refreshes the wheel mesh

vehicleSeatRoles.inputContexts: MVehicleInputControlsDataAsset has separate ActivePassenger and PassivePassenger InputMappingContexts arrays; none of the 15 cooked input-controls assets sets either (only DriverInputMappingContexts, and Gunner on 2).
vehicleSeatRoles.rules: All 17 gameplay-state queries and the Sprint, TacSprint and ping-request blocks that name a vehicle role list State.Player.Vehicle.Role.ActivePassenger and .PassivePassenger together.

waterHeight.formula: bilinear blend of the four nearest samples (cell centres at half-sample offsets); a sample of 65535 means no water and is left out of the blend (weights renormalised); height = low + sample / 65535 x (high - low); the subsystem returns max(height - query Z, 0), the water depth at the point

worldUnits: WorldToMeters is not stored in any of the four WDWorldSettings, so the engine default 100 applies: 1 Unreal unit = 1 cm
